subject: Scheduling: Security & Compliance Architecture Review (SOC 2 evidence, SSO, encryption, audit logs)
messages:

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Security & Compliance architecture review — proposed slots

Hi Alex,

Thanks again for the quick sync earlier. As discussed, we should get a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive scheduled with our security and infra leads so we can walk through the architecture and the artifacts you requested (SOC 2 evidence, encryption controls, audit log exports, and SSO configuration).

Proposed windows next week (PST):
- Tue 17 Feb, 14:00–15:15
- Wed 18 Feb, 09:00–10:15
- Thu 19 Feb, 11:00–12:15

Agenda (high level):
1) Introductions + scope (5m)
2) Architecture walkthrough (runtime, data flows, storage, key management) (25m)
3) Deep-dive: SOC 2 evidence mapping & retention (15m)
4) SSO (SAML/OIDC) configuration and test plan (10m)
5) Audit logs & export/demo of search/query (10m)
6) Action items / evidence delivery timeline (10m)

I've attached a short readiness checklist so you can flag anything you want us to prioritize. Please let me know which slot works and if you want anyone else added.

Attachments: [Attachment: SOC2_readiness_checklist.pdf (PDF)]

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Sales Engineer\Redwood Inference

Vanessa,

Thanks — Tuesday 17 Feb 14:00 PST would be ideal for us. Can you add our security engineer Samira (cc'd) to the invite? She'll want to confirm coverage of our specific evidence needs (encryption at rest keys, HSM/KMS integration details, and retention in audit logs).

Also, could you include a short SSO config doc in advance? Our IdP team prefers to review the SAML metadata and ACS endpoints before an architecture call.

Procurement wants to be looped after the meeting for SLA/contract timings — I cc'd procurement@nimbushealth.com for that.

Thanks,

Rishi/Vanessa —

Great session — thanks for the thorough walkthrough. A few follow-ups from our side:
- We need specific evidence items listed for SOC 2 control CC6 and CC7 (data encryption at rest and in transit). Could you provide the keys/key-rotation proof and KMS logs?
- Audit logs: we want a sample export of the last 30 days and an example of the query filters you'll use.
- SSO: Samira will follow up separately with the IdP metadata and requested test account details.

Procurement asked for an estimated timeline for delivery of the evidence artifacts and a draft SLA (they're aiming to have legal review next week). Can you provide an estimated delivery plan?

I'll attach meeting notes from our side in a follow-up.

Thanks,
Alex
